- [note/bursty_offload] For bursty Poisson 8-req bursts (2 req/us, p99<=0.4us) with min LUTs+FFs: pipelined_m dominated the front (m=4..7, dw=15..20, n_iter=12..13); winner pipelined_m dw=15/n_iter=12/m=7 (est 816 LUTs+FFs, 10.1 bits, sim p99 0.233us). L1 analytic p99 bounds under-predicted simulated p99 by ~1.4-1.5x (0.168->0.233) but all top-5 still passed. No recorded L3/L4 rows for pipelined_m designs, so no measured confirmation. (LLM note; runs 20261009-180818-45e2)
- [note/low_area_control] For area-min CORDIC specs, iterative dw=15/n_iter=12 wins; M1 cost model under-predicts LUTs ~19% and FFs ~11% vs yosys+nextpnr measured (216 LUT/107 FF vs est 159/92). No winner change at L5. (LLM note; runs 20261009-180432-41b1)
- [note/note/dds_250msps] For 1-sample/clock DDS specs (>=250 MSPS, min LUTs): only plain pipelined reached the front (dw 15..18, n_iter 14..16); pipelined_m (m=2..4, dw 14..17, n_iter 12..13) had 0 feasible in that box, and iterative can't hit 1/cycle. Winner pipelined dw=18/n_iter=15/angle_guard=2/frac_guard=1/trunc (est 949 LUTs, 13.1 bits, 264 MSPS). L2 DDS sim: SFDR 98.2 dBc, SNR 87.5 dB. No recorded L3/L4 rows for pipelined designs, so no measured confirmation. (LLM note; runs 20261009-181137-7737)

Spec queue:
- multiaxis_control [not started; 0/400 L1 evaluations used]
    spec multiaxis_control: Shared sin/cos unit for a 16-axis motor-control loop: a 1 MHz control tick issues 32 requests at once (Park + inverse Park per axis); all 32 results must be back within 0.44 us of the tick (p99 over ticks). Max error <= 2^-12. Minimise LUTs + FFs.
      constraint: throughput_msps >= 32
      constraint: max_abs_err <= 0.000244141
      constraint: sys_p99_batch_us <= 0.44
      objective: min luts_plus_ffs (HV ref 4000)
      objective: max accuracy_bits (HV ref 12)
      select: min luts_plus_ffs
      system (simulated at L2 for the shortlist; screened at L1 by an analytic bound): control loop: a tick every 1 us issues 32 requests at once (32 requests/us on average)
      budget: 400 evals, 100/round, <= 4 rounds, eps 0.01

args.notes: Spec: 32 requests per 1us tick, all results within 0.44us p99, min LUTs+FFs. From memory: pipelined_m dominated the front on the similar bursty spec (m=4..7, dw=15..20, n_iter=12..13); pipelined (dw 15..18, n_iter 14..16) reached the front on the 1/cycle DDS spec; iterative can't hit 1/cycle; unrolled_k never reached a front. L1 analytic p99 under-predicts simulated p99 ~1.4-1.5x, so keep margin on sys_p99_batch_us <= 0.44us.

args.lesson: For 32-req-per-tick batch specs (p99<=0.44us, min LUTs+FFs): pipelined_m m=2 dominated the front (dw 19..20, n_iter 14..16); winner pipelined_m dw=19/n_iter=14/m=2/trunc (est 1417 LUTs+FFs, 12.4 bits, 164 MSPS, sim p99 0.243us). L1 analytic p99 under-predicted sim by ~2.5% (0.237->0.243), much less than the ~1.4-1.5x on the bursty spec. No recorded L3/L4 rows for pipelined_m, so no measured confirmation.
